title: Spectre Charger
description:
When toggled on by right clicking, the Spectre Charger will transfer energy from your spectre energy buffer into any item in your inventory that can accept it. The charger has to be carried in your inventory (any slot) to work. Right click again to toggle it off.

The energy per tick each item gets increases with the tier. The rate applies to every item being charged, not to all items together.

- Normal: 1024 per Tick

- Redstone: 4096 per Tick

- Ender: 20480 per Tick

The Genesis Charger is creative only and basically charges the items as fast as possible for free.

Your spectre energy buffer holds up to 1,000,000 energy and is filled by the Spectre Energy Injector. The injector connects to the buffer of the player who placed it and accepts energy from any side; it can not give energy back out.

Your spectre energy buffer is shared between all dimensions.
